headlines.title: Nasdaq futures slide over 2% as AI losses deepen; inflation data in focus - Reuters
headlines.summary: The MONDAY euphoria is ALREADY unwinding — Nasdaq futures down 2%-plus as the AI trade faces a reckoning that one CEO reinstatement cannot paper over, and now the market must stare directly into an inflation print that could hand the Fed a LOADED GUN. This is the double-barrel scenario: tech multiple compression meeting a hawkish macro catalyst, hitting QQQ, NVDA, and every AI-adjacent name simultaneously. The consensus said the bottom was in; the consensus is usually wrong.

headlines.title: Trump administration set to unveil new tariffs after probe on excess factory capacity, sources say - Reuters
headlines.summary: New tariffs targeting EXCESS factory capacity — read: China — arriving precisely when markets are already fragile is the kind of ACCELERANT that turns a tech selloff into a broad-market rout. Industrials, materials, and any multinational with China supply chain exposure get repriced overnight; the Bloomberg headline 'China Hits Back' confirms Beijing is not sitting quietly. This is the geopolitical wildcard that the bulls conveniently forgot to price in during Monday's relief rally.

headlines.title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength, company authorizes $25 billion buyback
headlines.summary: Dell's sales MORE THAN DOUBLED on AI server demand and they're handing back $25 billion to shareholders — this is the rare earnings print that actually VALIDATES the capex thesis rather than just promising future returns, and it drags the entire AI infrastructure complex with it: HPE, Super Micro, and the hyperscalers who are Dell's customers. The cynical read is that one strong quarter doesn't resolve the margin compression story, but the market will chase the headline number first and ask questions later.
